messages.content: What is the largest planet in the universe?

message.content:
The largest planet that has been confirmed so far is **HD 100546 b**.  
It orbits the young star HD 100546 and has a radius of roughly **2.5 × Jupiter’s radius** (about 18,000 km). This makes it the biggest planet we’ve been able to measure directly. (Other very large candidates exist, but HD 100546 b is the most massive and well‑studied one.)
